title: dont duplicate content
rule: Don’t duplicate content (no second page title under the title bar; no extra nav that copies App nav).
pass_when: One page title; no extra nav that copies App nav.
fail_when: A second title under the title bar, or duplicate App nav.
overview: One page title; do not duplicate App nav under the title bar.
apply_when: Structuring page chrome, titles, and navigation in admin UI.
not_when: A second title under the title bar or duplicate App nav.
agent_hint: Keep one page title and avoid extra nav that copies App navigation.
description: Don’t duplicate content: there should be one page title and no extra navigation that copies App nav. Pass when the page has a single title and does not add a second nav that mirrors App navigation. Fail when a second title sits under the title bar, or when duplicate App nav appears and competes with the primary navigation.
